_comment: Hugging Face repositories of each registry name. repo_id is the base model, pinned to the revision of the paper's numbers because its main branch can change the chat template or remote code; w64 is the shared-KV (W = 64) target and drafters hold the drafter of each target. Dory shares without adaptation: both of its targets are the pinned base checkpoint with configuration overrides (loops 4, kv_policy w64 or native), so it has no w64 repository, and one drafter serves both. dspark_drafters hold a model's DSpark drafters, which run when a model has no other drafter or with --drafter-kind dspark. Inkling-2-Mini runs per-loop KV only (no KV sharing, so w64 is null) and has no drafter yet: pass a drafter explicitly or run block size one. inkling-2-mini-varloop is the variable-loop checkpoint of the same architecture, tokenizer and chat template (its early passes are trained to read out), with its own DSpark drafter; it is a separate model: its traces, drafters and results are never mixed with Inkling-2-Mini's.
